## Summary

<!--
Draft. What it should land on is open in issue #5.
-->

- Agents can read data, implement, optimise and review models, and build
  the infrastructure around them
- Use the time they free for review, big-picture thinking and deep dives,
  rather than more incremental work
- They push towards complex code that is hard to review. They get things
  wrong, and retrospective scores can leak
- Working together through agents is hard. We have not solved it
